race.description: BMWCA Accountants Classic Burnett To The Beach Series Hcp (55)
race.comment: I AM PIETRA (11) looks the most reliable winning option after going close in a Class B at Eidsvold, where she was second to Anthropology and beaten just over a length. She has the right profile back around 1170m, with one win and two placings from four starts at the distance, and the weight relief strengthens her case. GIGI FILLE (15) brings a different profile after winning a BM50 at Emerald on soft ground at an outside price, beating Luna Ready by just under two lengths. The rise in grade asks more of her, but she has won at this distance and arrives in better touch than many. REEBAR (14) is hard to ignore at this track and distance, having won three of five, and his last-start Class 3 win here as a short odds-on favourite gives him a genuine claim despite a wide draw. RAYGUN EXPRESS (10) was unwanted in betting first-up at Kilcoy but still worked home into fifth, and her past record around 1170m gives her a sound place profile if she builds second-up.
